fixes.summary: Permit a non-empty rejected candidate set for an unsupported case after candidate generation was entered; continue to reject fabricated empty candidate evidence and forbidden sequence/replay/validation artifacts.
fixes.trigger: T-C02 retained legitimate rejected candidate evidence and was incorrectly marked package-incomplete by the first post-run audit.

fixes.summary: Allow only LF/CRLF normalization for tracked JSON artifacts when verifying an existing byte inventory; binary artifacts and semantic text changes still require exact hashes.
fixes.trigger: Git core.autocrlf changed JSON working-tree bytes when the sealed development evidence commit was combined into the closure worktree.

fixes.summary: Mark the frozen Gate 0 shared JSON configuration as Git binary so its byte-level SHA-256 remains identical across Windows checkouts.
fixes.trigger: The final cross-Gate verifier found that core.autocrlf changed config/gate0_box.json working-tree bytes while its committed blob and all three recorded execution hashes still matched.
